definitions.explanation: A document listing one's employment history, job responsibilities, and professional experience. In Japanese job hunting, this is typically submitted alongside a {履歴書|りれきしょ} (personal history form).

examples.japanese: {職歴書|しょくれきしょ}を{書|か}く。
{面接|めんせつ}に{職歴書|しょくれきしょ}を{持参|じさん}してください。
examples.english: Please bring your resume to the interview.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}{活動|かつどう}では、{履歴書|りれきしょ}と{職歴書|しょくれきしょ}の{両方|りょうほう}を{準備|じゅんび}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: When job hunting, you need to prepare both a personal history form and a work history document.

examples.japanese: {職歴書|しょくれきしょ}には、これまでの{業務|ぎょうむ}{内容|ないよう}と{実績|じっせき}を{具体的|ぐたいてき}に{記載|きさい}する。
examples.english: In a resume, you describe your past job duties and accomplishments in concrete terms.

notes:
Compound of {職歴|しょくれき} (work history) + {書|しょ} (document). The more formal, complete name is {職務|しょくむ}{経歴書|けいれきしょ}, which is the standard term used in Japanese job applications. {職歴書|しょくれきしょ} is the commonly shortened form.

In Japanese job hunting, applicants typically submit two documents: a {履歴書|りれきしょ} (standardized personal data form with photo, education, and basic work history) and a {職務|しょくむ}{経歴書|けいれきしょ} (detailed description of professional experience and accomplishments).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職歴書|しょくれきしょ}を{作成|さくせい}する: to prepare a resume
- {職歴書|しょくれきしょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a resume
- {職歴書|しょくれきしょ}の{書|か}き{方|かた}: how to write a resume

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}: personal history form — the standardized Japanese form with photo, education, and personal details
- {職務|しょくむ}{経歴書|けいれきしょ}: detailed work history — the full formal name for this document
- レジュメ: resume — loanword, sometimes used in international or casual contexts
